node.releasePolicy: RoachNet, RoachNet Setup and roachnet-runtime contain and launch no Node or JavaScript (ROA-78). The builder refuses any bundle that holds a node binary, node_modules, .js/.mjs/.cjs/.node files or RoachNet source. Node is only used by the repository's developer and release tooling under scripts/, on a developer's Mac or in CI; none of it ships.

ollama.replacement: RoachInference (native/macos/Sources/RoachInference), served by roachnet-runtime's Ollama-compatible model server
ollama.releasePolicy: RoachNet 1.1+ bundles no Ollama runner. Models already in an Ollama models folder are read in place, and a user-installed Ollama stays an optional engine (ROACHNET_INFERENCE_ENGINE=ollama).
ollama.reviewNotes: 2026-10-09: retired after the M2 Pro Mac gate. Native Metal decode is within ~10% of Ollama 0.40.1 on 1.5B-3B models and faster on 0.5B; CPU and Metal produce identical tokens on six reference models (ROA-30, ROA-33).

openclaw.releasePolicy: RoachNet never bundles, installs or starts OpenClaw. RoachClaw only probes an OpenClaw the person runs themselves (OPENCLAW_BASE_URL, loopback by default) as an optional compatibility lane.
